choices: count must be public to be printed
A static method cannot read an instance field, because there is no object to read it from
println cannot print a private field
report() must return int rather than void
explanation: count belongs to an object and there may be many objects or none; report() belongs to the class and runs without one, so there is no particular count for it to read. Either make the field static so there is exactly one, or make report() an instance method called on an object. Visibility is a red herring - private is fine inside the same class.
hints: Ask which object's count the static method would be printing.
